issues.description: The Meal constructor parameter order in the template does not match the problem specification and the solution. The problem UML and the Main usage expect Meal(String name, String[] ingredients), and the solution implements that order, but the template's Meal class declares public Meal(String[] ingredients, String name). This mismatch will confuse students and causes the provided Main examples to not compile against the template.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the constructor signature in the template Meal class to public Meal(String name, String[] ingredients) so it matches the UML in the problem statement and the Main usage (and the solution). Update the parameter order inside the constructor accordingly.
